title: Models for planing and coding
body: Hi, I am a hobby dev using currently qwen 3.8 27b on my strix halo machine for coding. I was wondering what is the best approach to speed up. My idea is to use a moe like ornith 1.5 for planning and defining the tickets and qwen 3.8 27b for the implementation. What is your approach? submitted by /u/Intelligent_Lab1491 [link] [comments]
